name: GO MO Group — API & Machine-Readable Endpoint Catalog
description: Machine-readable catalog of all structured resources, discovery files, agent-accessible pages, and REST API endpoints published by GO MO Group (gomogroup.com). Includes a functional read-only REST API at /agent/v1/ serving JSON responses for company, services, case studies, team, and offices. The 'apis' array follows the APIs.json 0.16 specification (apisjson.org). Intended for AI agents, LLMs, crawlers, and automated systems.

apis.name: Agent Layer — Machine-Readable Site Representation
apis.description: Primary machine-readable endpoint for AI agents and LLMs. Semantic HTML5 page containing the complete representation of gomogroup.com: organisation data, all services, 18+ case studies, 8 leadership profiles, FAQ, offices, careers, and a full page index. Includes a 24-node JSON-LD @graph schema (Organization, WebPage, FAQPage, Person×8, Service×12, ItemList).

properties.description: 24-node JSON-LD @graph embedded in page — Organization, WebPage, FAQPage, Person, Service, ItemList
Human-readable version of the same content

apis.name: LLMs.txt — Plain Text LLM Discovery File
apis.description: Plain text file following the llms.txt standard (Jeremy Howard / Answer.AI). Contains a concise, structured summary of GO MO Group: company overview, all services with descriptions and pricing, solutions by segment, key results/proof points, office addresses, full leadership roster with contact details, key page URLs, case study URLs, blog post index, social media links, and Swedish hreflang alternates.

apis.name: AI.txt — AI Agent Permissions File
apis.description: Structured permissions file declaring what AI agents and LLMs are authorised to do with gomogroup.com content. Grants Allow-Indexing, Allow-Summarization, Allow-Citation, Allow-Training, and Allow-Retrieval. Includes preferred citation format, canonical machine-readable sources, contact for AI queries, key facts (services, results), and disallowed uses.

properties.description: Allow-Indexing: yes | Allow-Summarization: yes | Allow-Citation: yes | Allow-Training: yes | Allow-Retrieval: yes

apis.name: API Catalog — This File
apis.description: Self-referential entry. Machine-readable JSON catalog of all GO MO Group endpoints following the APIs.json 0.16 specification. Intended as a discovery document for AI agents, crawlers, and automated systems.

apis.name: GO MO Group Public REST API
apis.description: REST API serving clean URLs at /agent/v1/. GET endpoints return structured JSON for company, services, case studies, team, and offices. POST /contact.json accepts agent-submitted B2B inquiries with explicit user consent (user_authorized_submission: true required). No authentication required. Powered by a WordPress plugin using rewrite rules and template_redirect — no /wp-json/ prefix.

properties.description: Submit a qualified B2B inquiry — requires agent_context.user_authorized_submission: true

apis.name: MCP Server — Agent-Actionable Tool Interface
apis.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposing GO MO Group data and actions as callable tools for AI agents and LLM applications. Uses Streamable HTTP transport. Wraps the /agent/v1/ REST API. Tools: get_company, list_services, get_service, list_case_studies, get_case_study, list_team, list_offices, submit_contact_inquiry (requires user consent).

properties.name: get_company
properties.description: Returns company identity, certifications, and contact details

properties.name: list_services

properties.name: get_case_study

properties.name: submit_contact_inquiry
properties.description: Submits a B2B inquiry — requires user_authorized_submission: true

apis.name: XML Sitemap
apis.description: Standard XML sitemap listing all crawlable pages on gomogroup.com. Covers English and Swedish pages, services, case studies, insights, careers, and team profiles.

References LLM-Readable, LLM-Text, and Sitemap discovery directives.
